blocks.prompt: 3 (i) Find the inverse of the following quadratic function. Also find its domain and range: \(f(x) = x^2 - 3,\ x \le 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Poore real numbers par quadratic one-one nahin hota (aik hi output do inputs se aata hai), lekin yahan sirf aadha parabola diya gaya hai, yani vertex ki aik taraf. Is hisse par function one-one hai, is liye inverse mumkin hai.
Humein \(f^{-1}(x)\) aur \(f^{-1}\) ka domain aur range find karna hai.
Plan: pehle \(f\) ko vertex form mein likh kar us ki range nikaalenge; phir \(x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah badlenge; \(y\) ke liye hal karenge; root ka woh sign rakhenge jo diye gaye domain se mail khaye; aakhir mein Domain \(f^{-1}\) = Range \(f\) aur Range \(f^{-1}\) = Domain \(f\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = x^2 - 3\), domain \(x \le 0\) (yani parabola ka baayan aadha hissa).
Humein find karna hai: \(f^{-1}(x)\), Domain \(f^{-1}\) aur Range \(f^{-1}\).
Tareeqa: \(x\) aur \(y\) badlein, \(y\) nikaalein, aur \(y \le 0\) ki madad se root ka sign chunein.

\(f\) ka domain aur range
\[\text{Domain } f = (-\infty,\ 0]\]
\[x \le 0 \Rightarrow x^2 \ge 0 \Rightarrow x^2 - 3 \ge -3\]
\[\text{Range } f = [-3,\ \infty)\]
Kyun: vertex \((0, -3)\) hai aur \(x = 0\) domain mein shamil hai, is liye \(-3\) waqai output banta hai. Jaise jaise \(x\) baayen \(-\infty\) ki taraf jata hai, \(x^2\) be-had bara hota jata hai.

\(x\) aur \(y\) badlein
\[y = x^2 - 3 \;\longrightarrow\; x = y^2 - 3\]
Kyun: inverse function \(f\) ka kaam ulta kar deta hai: agar \(f\) ne \(a\) ko \(b\) banaya, to \(f^{-1}\) \(b\) ko wapas \(a\) bana deta hai. \(x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah badalna yahi baat likhne ka tareeqa hai, jaise ghar se school ka raasta ulta chalein to school se ghar pohanch jate hain.

\(y\) ke liye hal karein
\[y^2 = x + 3\]
\[y = \pm\sqrt{x + 3}\]
Kyun: dono taraf 3 jama kiya, phir square root liya. Square root lene par hamesha do sign aate hain, \(+\) aur \(-\), kyun ke \(2^2\) aur \((-2)^2\) dono 4 hain.

Sahih sign chunein
\[y \le 0 \Rightarrow y = -\sqrt{x + 3}\]
\[f^{-1}(x) = -\sqrt{x + 3}\]
Kyun: \(f^{-1}\) ke outputs \(f\) ke inputs hone chahiye, jo \(\le 0\) hain. \(+\sqrt{x + 3}\) kabhi negative nahin hota, is liye woh ghalat (daayan) aadha hissa deta.
Dhyan dein: sign chunna is sawal ka sab se ahem qadam hai; \(\pm\) likh kar chhor dena adhoora jawab hai.

\(f^{-1}\) ka domain aur range
\[\text{Domain } f^{-1} = \text{Range } f = [-3,\ \infty)\]
\[\text{Range } f^{-1} = \text{Domain } f = (-\infty,\ 0]\]
Kyun: \(f^{-1}\) ke inputs wohi hain jo \(f\) ke outputs the, aur \(f^{-1}\) ke outputs wohi hain jo \(f\) ke inputs the. Is liye domain aur range bas jagah badal lete hain; naya hisaab karne ki zaroorat nahin. Saath hi \(\sqrt{x + 3}\) ke liye \(x \ge -3\) zaroori hai, yeh bhi mil gaya.

Tasdeeq
\[f(-2) = 4 - 3 = 1\]
\[f^{-1}(1) = -\sqrt{4} = -2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(f\) ne \(-2\) ko 1 banaya, aur \(f^{-1}\) ne 1 ko wapas \(-2\) bana diya. Yahi inverse ki pehchan hai.

blocks.prompt: 3 (ii) Find the inverse of the following quadratic function. Also find its domain and range: \(f(x) = x^2 + 6x + 4,\ x < -3\).
blocks.explanation:
Poore real numbers par quadratic one-one nahin hota (aik hi output do inputs se aata hai), lekin yahan sirf aadha parabola diya gaya hai, yani vertex ki aik taraf. Is hisse par function one-one hai, is liye inverse mumkin hai.
Humein \(f^{-1}(x)\) aur \(f^{-1}\) ka domain aur range find karna hai.
Plan: pehle \(f\) ko vertex form mein likh kar us ki range nikaalenge; phir \(x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah badlenge; \(y\) ke liye hal karenge; root ka woh sign rakhenge jo diye gaye domain se mail khaye; aakhir mein Domain \(f^{-1}\) = Range \(f\) aur Range \(f^{-1}\) = Domain \(f\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = x^2 + 6x + 4\), domain \(x < -3\).
Humein find karna hai: \(f^{-1}(x)\), Domain \(f^{-1}\) aur Range \(f^{-1}\).
Tareeqa: vertex form, phir \(x, y\) badalna, hal karna, aur \(y < -3\) se sign chunna.

Vertex form
\[f(x) = x^2 + 6x + 9 - 9 + 4\]
\[f(x) = (x + 3)^2 - 5\]
Kyun: 6 ka aadha 3, us ka square 9; 9 jama aur minus kiya. Vertex \((-3, -5)\) hai. Dekhiye, domain \(x < -3\) bilkul vertex se shuru hota hai, yani hamein vertex ki baayen taraf wala hissa mila hai.

\(f\) ka domain aur range
\[x < -3 \Rightarrow (x + 3)^2 > 0\]
\[\text{Range } f = (-5,\ \infty)\]
Kyun: \(x = -3\) allowed nahin (sirf \(<\), barabar nahin), is liye \((x + 3)^2\) kabhi zero nahin hota aur \(f(x)\) kabhi \(-5\) nahin banta. \(-5\) se ooper har value milti hai, is liye gol bracket.

Badlein aur hal karein
\[x = (y + 3)^2 - 5\]
\[(y + 3)^2 = x + 5\]
\[y + 3 = \pm\sqrt{x + 5}\]
Kyun: inverse function \(f\) ka kaam ulta kar deta hai: agar \(f\) ne \(a\) ko \(b\) banaya, to \(f^{-1}\) \(b\) ko wapas \(a\) bana deta hai. \(x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah badalna yahi baat likhne ka tareeqa hai, jaise ghar se school ka raasta ulta chalein to school se ghar pohanch jate hain. Phir square ko akela kar ke root liya, jis se do sign aaye.

Sahih sign chunein
\[y < -3 \Rightarrow y + 3 < 0\]
\[y = -3 - \sqrt{x + 5}\]
\[f^{-1}(x) = -3 - \sqrt{x + 5}\]
Kyun: \(y + 3\) negative hona chahiye, is liye \(-\sqrt{x + 5}\) rakha. Kitab quadratic formula se hal karti hai; us se bhi yahi do umeedwar \(y = -3 \pm \sqrt{x + 5}\) milte hain, aur sign isi tarah chuna jata hai.

\(f^{-1}\) ka domain aur range
\[\text{Domain } f^{-1} = \text{Range } f = (-5,\ \infty)\]
\[\text{Range } f^{-1} = \text{Domain } f = (-\infty,\ -3)\]
Kyun: \(f^{-1}\) ke inputs wohi hain jo \(f\) ke outputs the, aur \(f^{-1}\) ke outputs wohi hain jo \(f\) ke inputs the. Is liye domain aur range bas jagah badal lete hain; naya hisaab karne ki zaroorat nahin. Waqai \(-3 - \sqrt{x + 5}\) hamesha \(-3\) se chhota hai, kyun ke us mein se aik positive number minus ho raha hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f(-5) = 25 - 30 + 4 = -1\]
\[f^{-1}(-1) = -3 - \sqrt{4} = -5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(f\) ne \(-5\) ko \(-1\) banaya aur \(f^{-1}\) ne \(-1\) ko wapas \(-5\) kar diya.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key (safha 296) mein Q3 (ii) ke liye Range \(f^{-1} = (-3,\ \infty)\) chhapa hai. \(f^{-1}\) ki range \(f\) ka domain hoti hai, jo \(x < -3\) hai; is liye sahih range \((-\infty,\ -3)\) hai. \(f^{-1}(x)\) aur domain key mein theek hain.

blocks.prompt: 3 (iii) Find the inverse of the following quadratic function. Also find its domain and range: \(f(x) = 2x^2 - 8x + 11,\ x \ge 2\).
blocks.explanation:
Poore real numbers par quadratic one-one nahin hota (aik hi output do inputs se aata hai), lekin yahan sirf aadha parabola diya gaya hai, yani vertex ki aik taraf. Is hisse par function one-one hai, is liye inverse mumkin hai.
Humein \(f^{-1}(x)\) aur \(f^{-1}\) ka domain aur range find karna hai.
Plan: pehle \(f\) ko vertex form mein likh kar us ki range nikaalenge; phir \(x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah badlenge; \(y\) ke liye hal karenge; root ka woh sign rakhenge jo diye gaye domain se mail khaye; aakhir mein Domain \(f^{-1}\) = Range \(f\) aur Range \(f^{-1}\) = Domain \(f\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 2x^2 - 8x + 11\), domain \(x \ge 2\).
Humein find karna hai: \(f^{-1}(x)\), Domain \(f^{-1}\) aur Range \(f^{-1}\).
Tareeqa: vertex form, badalna, hal karna, aur \(y \ge 2\) se sign chunna.

Vertex form
\[f(x) = 2(x^2 - 4x) + 11\]
\[f(x) = 2(x^2 - 4x + 4 - 4) + 11\]
\[f(x) = 2(x - 2)^2 - 8 + 11\]
\[f(x) = 2(x - 2)^2 + 3\]
Kyun: \(x\) wale terms se 2 common liya; \(-4\) ka aadha \(-2\), square 4. Andar wala \(-4\) bahar ke 2 se multiply ho kar \(-8\) banta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(-4\) ko bahar \(-4\) hi likh dena aam ghalti hai; bahar ka multiplier zaroor lagayein.

\(f\) ka domain aur range
\[x \ge 2 \Rightarrow 2(x - 2)^2 \ge 0\]
\[\text{Range } f = [3,\ \infty)\]
Kyun: domain bilkul vertex \((2, 3)\) se shuru hota hai aur use shamil karta hai, is liye sab se chhota output 3 waqai milta hai, aur square bracket lagta hai.

Badlein aur hal karein
\[x = 2(y - 2)^2 + 3\]
\[(y - 2)^2 = \dfrac{x - 3}{2}\]
\[y - 2 = \pm\sqrt{\dfrac{x - 3}{2}}\]
Kyun: inverse function \(f\) ka kaam ulta kar deta hai: agar \(f\) ne \(a\) ko \(b\) banaya, to \(f^{-1}\) \(b\) ko wapas \(a\) bana deta hai. \(x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah badalna yahi baat likhne ka tareeqa hai, jaise ghar se school ka raasta ulta chalein to school se ghar pohanch jate hain.

Sign chunein aur simplify karein
\[y \ge 2 \Rightarrow y = 2 + \sqrt{\dfrac{x - 3}{2}}\]
\[\sqrt{\dfrac{x - 3}{2}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{2(x - 3)}{4}} = \dfrac{\sqrt{2(x - 3)}}{2}\]
\[f^{-1}(x) = \dfrac{4 + \sqrt{2(x - 3)}}{2}\]
Kyun: \(y - 2 \ge 0\) hai, is liye \(+\) root. Root ke andar \(\tfrac{2}{2}\) se multiply karne se denominator 4 ban jata hai jis ka root 2 hai; is tarah answer key wali shakal milti hai. Dono shaklein barabar hain.

\(f^{-1}\) ka domain aur range
\[\text{Domain } f^{-1} = \text{Range } f = [3,\ \infty)\]
\[\text{Range } f^{-1} = \text{Domain } f = [2,\ \infty)\]
Kyun: \(f^{-1}\) ke inputs wohi hain jo \(f\) ke outputs the, aur \(f^{-1}\) ke outputs wohi hain jo \(f\) ke inputs the. Is liye domain aur range bas jagah badal lete hain; naya hisaab karne ki zaroorat nahin. Saath hi \(\sqrt{2(x - 3)}\) sirf \(x \ge 3\) par real hai.

Tasdeeq
\[f(3) = 18 - 24 + 11 = 5\]
\[f^{-1}(5) = \dfrac{4 + \sqrt{4}}{2} = 3 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(f\) ne 3 ko 5 banaya aur \(f^{-1}\) ne 5 ko wapas 3 kar diya.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key (safha 296) mein Q3 (iii) ke liye root \(\sqrt{2\ -3 + x}\) bina brackets ke chhapa hai aur Domain \(f^{-1} = [-3,\ \infty)\) likha hai. Sahih: \(f^{-1}(x) = \dfrac{4 + \sqrt{2(x - 3)}}{2}\) aur Domain \(f^{-1} = [3,\ \infty)\), kyun ke \(x \ge 2\) par \(f = 2(x - 2)^2 + 3\) ki range \([3,\ \infty)\) hai. Range \([2,\ \infty)\) theek hai.

blocks.prompt: 3 (iv) Find the inverse of the following quadratic function. Also find its domain and range: \(f(x) = 3x^2 - 2x + 6,\ x \ge 5\).
blocks.explanation:
Poore real numbers par quadratic one-one nahin hota (aik hi output do inputs se aata hai), lekin yahan sirf aadha parabola diya gaya hai, yani vertex ki aik taraf. Is hisse par function one-one hai, is liye inverse mumkin hai.
Humein \(f^{-1}(x)\) aur \(f^{-1}\) ka domain aur range find karna hai.
Plan: pehle \(f\) ko vertex form mein likh kar us ki range nikaalenge; phir \(x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah badlenge; \(y\) ke liye hal karenge; root ka woh sign rakhenge jo diye gaye domain se mail khaye; aakhir mein Domain \(f^{-1}\) = Range \(f\) aur Range \(f^{-1}\) = Domain \(f\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 3x^2 - 2x + 6\), domain \(x \ge 5\).
Humein find karna hai: \(f^{-1}(x)\), Domain \(f^{-1}\) aur Range \(f^{-1}\).
Tareeqa: vertex form, badalna, hal karna, aur \(y \ge 5\) se sign chunna.

Vertex form
\[f(x) = 3\left(x^2 - \tfrac{2}{3}x\right) + 6\]
\[f(x) = 3\left(x^2 - \tfrac{2}{3}x + \tfrac{1}{9} - \tfrac{1}{9}\right) + 6\]
\[f(x) = 3\left(x - \tfrac{1}{3}\right)^2 - \tfrac{1}{3} + 6\]
\[f(x) = 3\left(x - \tfrac{1}{3}\right)^2 + \tfrac{17}{3}\]
Kyun: \(\tfrac{2}{3}\) ka aadha \(\tfrac{1}{3}\), square \(\tfrac{1}{9}\). \(3 \times (-\tfrac{1}{9}) = -\tfrac{1}{3}\), aur \(6 - \tfrac{1}{3} = \tfrac{18 - 1}{3} = \tfrac{17}{3}\).

\(f\) ka domain aur range
\[f(5) = 75 - 10 + 6 = 71\]
\[\text{Range } f = [71,\ \infty)\]
Kyun: yeh is sawal ka khaas nukta hai. Vertex \(x = \tfrac{1}{3}\) par hai jo domain \(x \ge 5\) mein shamil hi nahin. \(x \ge 5\) vertex ki daayen taraf hai jahan function barhta hi jata hai, is liye sab se chhota output \(f(5) = 71\) hai, \(\tfrac{17}{3}\) nahin.
Dhyan dein: range hamesha vertex se shuru nahin hoti; pehle dekhein ke diya gaya domain vertex se shuru hota hai ya us se aage.

Badlein aur hal karein
\[x = 3\left(y - \tfrac{1}{3}\right)^2 + \tfrac{17}{3}\]
\[\left(y - \tfrac{1}{3}\right)^2 = \dfrac{3x - 17}{9}\]
\[y - \tfrac{1}{3} = \pm\dfrac{\sqrt{3x - 17}}{3}\]
Kyun: inverse function \(f\) ka kaam ulta kar deta hai: agar \(f\) ne \(a\) ko \(b\) banaya, to \(f^{-1}\) \(b\) ko wapas \(a\) bana deta hai. \(x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah badalna yahi baat likhne ka tareeqa hai, jaise ghar se school ka raasta ulta chalein to school se ghar pohanch jate hain. Yahan \(\tfrac{x - 17/3}{3}\) ko 3 se ooper neeche multiply kar ke \(\tfrac{3x - 17}{9}\) banaya, aur \(\sqrt{9} = 3\).

Sahih sign chunein
\[y \ge 5 \Rightarrow y - \tfrac{1}{3} > 0\]
\[f^{-1}(x) = \dfrac{1 + \sqrt{3x - 17}}{3}\]
Kyun: \(-\) sign lene se \(y \le \tfrac{1}{3}\) aata, jo 5 se bohat neeche hai. Is liye \(+\) rakha.

\(f^{-1}\) ka domain aur range
\[\text{Domain } f^{-1} = \text{Range } f = [71,\ \infty)\]
\[\text{Range } f^{-1} = \text{Domain } f = [5,\ \infty)\]
Kyun: \(f^{-1}\) ke inputs wohi hain jo \(f\) ke outputs the, aur \(f^{-1}\) ke outputs wohi hain jo \(f\) ke inputs the. Is liye domain aur range bas jagah badal lete hain; naya hisaab karne ki zaroorat nahin. Sirf formula dekhein to \(x \ge \tfrac{17}{3}\) bhi chal jata, lekin diye gaye \(f\) ke outputs sirf \(x \ge 71\) hain; is liye domain \([71,\ \infty)\).

Tasdeeq
\[f^{-1}(71) = \dfrac{1 + \sqrt{213 - 17}}{3}\]
\[= \dfrac{1 + 14}{3} = 5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(f(5) = 71\) hai, is liye \(f^{-1}(71)\) ko 5 hona chahiye, aur wahi aaya.

blocks.prompt: 3 (v) Find the inverse of the following quadratic function. Also find its domain and range: \(f(x) = 2(x - 3)^2 + 1,\ x \ge 3\).
blocks.explanation:
Poore real numbers par quadratic one-one nahin hota (aik hi output do inputs se aata hai), lekin yahan sirf aadha parabola diya gaya hai, yani vertex ki aik taraf. Is hisse par function one-one hai, is liye inverse mumkin hai.
Humein \(f^{-1}(x)\) aur \(f^{-1}\) ka domain aur range find karna hai.
Plan: pehle \(f\) ko vertex form mein likh kar us ki range nikaalenge; phir \(x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah badlenge; \(y\) ke liye hal karenge; root ka woh sign rakhenge jo diye gaye domain se mail khaye; aakhir mein Domain \(f^{-1}\) = Range \(f\) aur Range \(f^{-1}\) = Domain \(f\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 2(x - 3)^2 + 1\), domain \(x \ge 3\). Yeh pehle hi vertex form mein hai, vertex \((3, 1)\).
Humein find karna hai: \(f^{-1}(x)\), Domain \(f^{-1}\) aur Range \(f^{-1}\).
Tareeqa: badalna, hal karna, aur \(y \ge 3\) se sign chunna. Completing square ki zaroorat nahin, kaam aadha reh gaya.

\(f\) ka domain aur range
\[x \ge 3 \Rightarrow 2(x - 3)^2 \ge 0\]
\[\text{Range } f = [1,\ \infty)\]
Kyun: domain vertex se shuru ho kar use shamil karta hai, is liye sab se chhota output \(f(3) = 1\) hai.

Badlein aur hal karein
\[x = 2(y - 3)^2 + 1\]
\[(y - 3)^2 = \dfrac{x - 1}{2}\]
\[y - 3 = \pm\sqrt{\dfrac{x - 1}{2}}\]
Kyun: inverse function \(f\) ka kaam ulta kar deta hai: agar \(f\) ne \(a\) ko \(b\) banaya, to \(f^{-1}\) \(b\) ko wapas \(a\) bana deta hai. \(x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah badalna yahi baat likhne ka tareeqa hai, jaise ghar se school ka raasta ulta chalein to school se ghar pohanch jate hain. Hal karte waqt operations ulti tarteeb mein khole: pehle 1 minus, phir 2 se divide, phir square root.

Sahih sign chunein
\[y \ge 3 \Rightarrow y = 3 + \sqrt{\dfrac{x - 1}{2}}\]
Kyun: \(y - 3 \ge 0\) hai, is liye \(+\) root rakha.
Dhyan dein: \(f^{-1}(x) = 3 + \sqrt{\tfrac{x - 1}{2}}\) ko \(\tfrac{1}{f(x)}\) na samjhein. \(f^{-1}\) ka matlab "ulta function" hai, "aik bata \(f\)" nahin; \(-1\) yahan power nahin balke nishaani hai.

\(f^{-1}\) ka domain aur range
\[\text{Domain } f^{-1} = \text{Range } f = [1,\ \infty)\]
\[\text{Range } f^{-1} = \text{Domain } f = [3,\ \infty)\]
Kyun: \(f^{-1}\) ke inputs wohi hain jo \(f\) ke outputs the, aur \(f^{-1}\) ke outputs wohi hain jo \(f\) ke inputs the. Is liye domain aur range bas jagah badal lete hain; naya hisaab karne ki zaroorat nahin.

Tasdeeq
\[f(5) = 2(4) + 1 = 9\]
\[f^{-1}(9) = 3 + \sqrt{4} = 5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(f\) ne 5 ko 9 banaya aur \(f^{-1}\) ne 9 ko wapas 5 kar diya.

blocks.prompt: 3 (vi) Find the inverse of the following quadratic function. Also find its domain and range: \(f(x) = -3(x + 4)^2 - 5,\ x < -4\).
blocks.explanation:
Poore real numbers par quadratic one-one nahin hota (aik hi output do inputs se aata hai), lekin yahan sirf aadha parabola diya gaya hai, yani vertex ki aik taraf. Is hisse par function one-one hai, is liye inverse mumkin hai.
Humein \(f^{-1}(x)\) aur \(f^{-1}\) ka domain aur range find karna hai.
Plan: pehle \(f\) ko vertex form mein likh kar us ki range nikaalenge; phir \(x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah badlenge; \(y\) ke liye hal karenge; root ka woh sign rakhenge jo diye gaye domain se mail khaye; aakhir mein Domain \(f^{-1}\) = Range \(f\) aur Range \(f^{-1}\) = Domain \(f\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = -3(x + 4)^2 - 5\), domain \(x < -4\). Vertex form hai, vertex \((-4, -5)\), parabola neeche khulta hai.
Humein find karna hai: \(f^{-1}(x)\), Domain \(f^{-1}\) aur Range \(f^{-1}\).
Tareeqa: badalna, hal karna, aur \(y < -4\) se sign chunna.

\(f\) ka domain aur range
\[x < -4 \Rightarrow (x + 4)^2 > 0\]
\[-3(x + 4)^2 < 0 \Rightarrow f(x) < -5\]
\[\text{Range } f = (-\infty,\ -5)\]
Kyun: \(x = -4\) shamil nahin (sirf \(<\)), is liye vertex wali value \(-5\) kabhi nahin milti, aur outputs neeche be-had tak jate hain. Positive square ko \(-3\) se multiply karne par negative banta hai, yaad rahe inequality yahan ulat jati hai.

Badlein aur hal karein
\[x = -3(y + 4)^2 - 5\]
\[(y + 4)^2 = \dfrac{-(x + 5)}{3}\]
\[y + 4 = \pm\sqrt{\dfrac{-(x + 5)}{3}}\]
Kyun: inverse function \(f\) ka kaam ulta kar deta hai: agar \(f\) ne \(a\) ko \(b\) banaya, to \(f^{-1}\) \(b\) ko wapas \(a\) bana deta hai. \(x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah badalna yahi baat likhne ka tareeqa hai, jaise ghar se school ka raasta ulta chalein to school se ghar pohanch jate hain. Root ke andar \(-(x + 5)\) dekh kar ghabrayein nahin: \(x < -5\) hai, is liye \(x + 5\) negative aur \(-(x + 5)\) positive hai.

Sahih sign chunein
\[y < -4 \Rightarrow y + 4 < 0\]
\[f^{-1}(x) = -4 - \sqrt{\dfrac{-(x + 5)}{3}}\]
Kyun: \(y + 4\) negative hona chahiye, is liye \(-\) wala root rakha. Aasaan qaida: agar diya gaya domain vertex ki baayen taraf hai (\(x <\) ya \(x \le\)) to minus wala root, aur daayen taraf hai (\(x >\) ya \(x \ge\)) to plus wala root.

\(f^{-1}\) ka domain aur range
\[\text{Domain } f^{-1} = \text{Range } f = (-\infty,\ -5)\]
\[\text{Range } f^{-1} = \text{Domain } f = (-\infty,\ -4)\]
Kyun: \(f^{-1}\) ke inputs wohi hain jo \(f\) ke outputs the, aur \(f^{-1}\) ke outputs wohi hain jo \(f\) ke inputs the. Is liye domain aur range bas jagah badal lete hain; naya hisaab karne ki zaroorat nahin. \(x < -5\) par root positive hai, is liye \(f^{-1}(x)\) hamesha \(-4\) se sakhti se chhota hai; \(-4\) kabhi nahin aata, is liye gol bracket.

Tasdeeq
\[f(-5) = -3(1) - 5 = -8\]
\[f^{-1}(-8) = -4 - \sqrt{\tfrac{3}{3}} = -5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(f\) ne \(-5\) ko \(-8\) banaya aur \(f^{-1}\) ne \(-8\) ko wapas \(-5\) kar diya.

blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key (safha 296) mein Q3 (vi) ke liye Range \(f^{-1} = (-\infty,\ -4]\) chhapa hai. \(f\) ka domain \(x < -4\) hai (barabar shamil nahin), is liye \(-4\) kabhi \(f^{-1}\) ka output nahin banta: sahih range \((-\infty,\ -4)\) hai.
